_readme: This is the ONE place to change LiphtUp fare pricing.
(server-authoritative fare charged to the passenger) both load this
exact file at runtime -- change a number here and it takes effect
everywhere, in both the quoted price and the charged price, with no
code edits required. JSON has no comment syntax, so this '_readme'
and the per-field '_docs' below are the comments; both are ignored
by the code (only the real fields are read).

_docs.services: One entry per ride service offered. The key ('bike', 'auto') is the vehicleType value used throughout the app and must stay lowercase.
_docs.services.<id>.name: Full display name shown to passengers, e.g. 'Auto'.
_docs.services.<id>.shortName: Compact label used in tight UI spaces, e.g. 'Auto'.
_docs.services.<id>.capacity: Number of passengers this vehicle can carry, e.g. 3.
_docs.services.<id>.baseFare: Flat starting charge in INR (rupees) added to every trip on this service, e.g. 25.
_docs.services.<id>.perKmRate: INR charged per kilometre of the FULL trip distance during normal hours (no distance-based discount tiers), e.g. 12.5.
_docs.services.<id>.nightPerKmRate: INR charged per kilometre when the ride is requested during night fare hours, e.g. 20.
_docs.services.<id>.minFare: The lowest possible fare in INR for this service, even for very short trips, e.g. 25.
_docs.nightFare: Optional time-based fare window. The request time decides the fare. Times use 24-hour HH:MM in the configured IANA timezone.
_docs.maxServiceableDistanceKm: Trips whose road distance (km) is longer than this are rejected as outside LiphtUp's current service area, e.g. 120.
_docs.fullFareProgressRatio: Fraction from 0 to 1 of the planned road distance the driver must actually have covered (by real road distance, not straight-line distance) before the passenger is charged the full quoted fare instead of a reduced one, e.g. 0.9 means 90%.
_docs.freeDropoffExtraKmKm: Extra road distance in km past the drop pin that is NOT billed, to allow for GPS drift and parking, e.g. 0.1 (100 metres).
_docs.zeroTravelThresholdKm: If the passenger travelled less than this many km after pickup, the trip is treated as no travel at all and the fare is charged as Rs 0, e.g. 0.01 (10 metres).
